title: What If the Moon Vanished? (Explained in 45 Seconds) 🌙 #shorts
description: Darker nights, weaker tides, and a wobbling planet. Here's what the Moon really does for us. #whatif #moon #science #shorts

scenes.say: What if the Moon vanished tonight?
First, nights would get much darker. No moonlight. Just faint starlight.
Next, the oceans. The Moon's gravity tugs on our seas, making them bulge. That's what creates most of the tides.
Without it, tides would shrink to about a third.
Many corals time their spawning with the full moon. They'd lose their calendar.
The Moon also keeps Earth's tilt steady, at about twenty-three degrees.
Without it, over millions of years, that tilt could swing wildly.
Bringing ice ages, and scorching heatwaves.
Darker nights. Weaker tides. A wobbling planet. So thank you, Moon! Follow for more what ifs.
